name: LaTeX Preview
description: Adds PDF and Editor | PDF views to .tex files: the compiled document, or the source and the PDF side by side, rebuilt as you type, with source and PDF jumps, autocomplete and an outline.

settings.title: TeX engine
settings.description: Auto uses a `% !TEX program = ...` comment when present, XeLaTeX when the preamble loads fontspec, unicode-math or polyglossia, and pdfLaTeX otherwise.

settings.title: Use latexmk when installed
settings.description: latexmk decides how many passes and when to run BibTeX or Biber. Without it the plugin runs the engine, the bibliography tool and the reruns itself.

settings.title: Compile as you type
settings.description: Rebuild after each pause in typing and whenever a project file changes on disk. Off means only the Recompile button builds.

settings.title: Delay before compiling (ms)
settings.description: How long to wait after the last change before compiling.

settings.title: Output folder
settings.description: Folder for the PDF and auxiliary files, relative to the main .tex file. Empty keeps them in Orca's cache (~/.cache/orca-latex-preview), so the project stays clean.

settings.title: Allow shell escape
settings.description: Pass -shell-escape, which packages such as minted need. It lets the document run commands on your machine, so enable it only for documents you trust.

settings.title: Extra TeX bin folder
settings.description: Searched before PATH, for a TeX Live that is not on Orca's PATH.
